Script (run this pass; `pes_full.bin` is a raw image, base `0x140000000`, so `file_off = VA - base`):
```python
import struct
f=open('<local>); base=0x140000000
def rd(va):
    f.seek(va-base); b=f.read(4)
    return struct.unpack('<f',b)[0], struct.unpack('<I',b)[0]
# vas = every 0x142xxxxxx cited anywhere in this report (grep-collected) + audit rows
for va in vas:
    v,i=rd(va); print(f"| `0x{va:X}` | `{v!r}` (`0x{i:08X}`) |")
```
